## Bug Fix Summary

**Bug:** License text on the Info page was not fully visible when scrolling.

**Root Cause:** In `app/src/main/res/layout/content_info.xml`, the `TextView` displaying the license text had `android:layout_width="wrap_content"`. This caused the TextView width to be determined by the text content rather than the screen width. For the GPL v3 license (which contains very long lines), this meant:
- Text lines wouldn't wrap properly within the visible screen area
- The scrollable content area didn't properly constrain the text to the screen width
- Users couldn't scroll to see the complete license

**Fix:** Changed `android:layout_width="wrap_content"` to `android:layout_width="match_parent"` on the `TextView` in `content_info.xml`. This ensures:
- The TextView fills the available screen width (minus margins)
- Text wraps naturally within the screen bounds
- The `NestedScrollView` properly handles vertical scrolling through the entire license

--- a/app/src/main/res/layout/content_info.xml
+++ b/app/src/main/res/layout/content_info.xml
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
     tools:showIn="@layout/activity_info">

     <TextView
-        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
+        android:layout_width="match_parent"
